free_tier.stated: 'Zoltan's FLOPs is a mini-grant program for GPU computing projects. The goal is to provide small-scale funding to help researchers and developers access GPU compute time on modern hardware.' Size, quoted: 'Total grant budget this iteration: $5,000', and '1-5 projects will be selected, depending on their compute requirements. The selected projects will get a portion of the total grant budget and can spend it on Vast.ai to provision on-demand GPU instances.' The gate is the whole point, quoted: 'Anyone can apply by filling out a simple form. There is no geographical restriction.' Selection, quoted: 'The selection criteria are purely based on my personal judgment, taking into account the project proposal, the background of the applicant, and the computing requirements.'

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: The only grant in this category with no geography clause, no entity clause and no institutional sponsor: USD 5,000 at Lambda's documented on-demand rate of USD 3.99 per H100 GPU-hour (compute/lambda) is about 1,253 H100-hours, which is more than enough for one reproducible experiment on a competition dataset. It composes with Zindi and DrivenData competitions, where the compute cost of entry is exactly this size.

limits.value: one person's judgement decides it: between one and five projects share USD 5,000, the deadline for the first iteration was April 15, 2025, and the page now reads 'Applications closed. Watch this site for results and future iterations.'
